Plan a 3 day trip to Jaipur for my parents
6:28 AM

Here's an easy 3 day Jaipur plan for your parents, with mornings for sightseeing and slow afternoons. Late October is pleasant weather there.

Day 1, Amer side: Amer Fort early, before the crowds. Go up by jeep to skip the steep walk. Stop at Jal Mahal for photos, rest after lunch, then Hawa Mahal and an evening stroll in Johari Bazaar.
Day 2, old city: City Palace and Jantar Mantar in the morning, a long lunch break, then Albert Hall Museum at sunset. Dinner at Chokhi Dhani for food and folk music.
Day 3, easy day: Govind Dev Ji Temple in the morning, Birla Mandir, then shopping for block-print fabrics and jewellery. Finish with Patrika Gate for photos before they leave.

Book a car with a driver for all three days so they aren't climbing in and out of autos. Tell me their dates, budget and how much walking they're comfortable with, and I'll tune the plan.

Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
6:32 AM

National Museum Delhi is open Tue to Fri, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and Sat and Sun, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. It is closed on Mondays and national holidays. Today (Sat 24 Oct) it is open 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Entry is ₹20 for adults and ₹500 for foreign nationals. Students up to class 12 enter free with an ID card. Tickets can be booked online at https://www.zoonga.com/national-museum. This is from the museum's own Plan Your Visit page.
